exactScorerComparisonFields.note: The scorer maps every relation object to its `relation` string before comparison. Object fields therefore do NOT affect scoring and are enforced separately by relationObjectIntegrity.

setListOrderSemantics.consequence: Every relation mismatch is necessarily MISSING-ONLY. An extra emitted relation can never fail an R3 row.

duplicateHandling: ignored by scoring; forbidden by relation-object integrity

emptyRelationSemantics.behaviour: a row with no expected relations passes the relation lane unconditionally

genericVersusSpecificCooccurrence.note: The generic treatment relation is never required by R3. Because extras are harmless under containment, emitting it alongside a specific relation is scoring-neutral; suppressing a REQUIRED specific relation is fatal.

normalizationAndAliasRules.aliasing: none — relation strings are compared verbatim

invalidRelationHandling: A relation outside the closed set can never satisfy an expectation and is rejected by relation-object integrity.
